svg.title: macOS · Photo viewer / grading editor · Masks tab · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift (masksTab) hosting App/Overlay/OverlayMasksPanel.swift — REBUILT 2026-09-07 from the Claude Design handoff "Masks as Adjustment Layers" (turn 3, the handover build). THE ONE RULE THIS TAB NOW OBEYS: a mask has two homes and the split is strict — this tab owns a mask’s SHAPE (create it, drag its handles, feather it, tune the semantic dials, see what text is placed in it); the EDITOR tab owns its GRADE (photo-viewer.mask-grade.svg). Same mask, two sides of it, and the TAB IS THE MODE: a drag on the picture here draws masks, a drag on the picture there sets an armed slider — nothing to remember. TOOLBAR: three 30pt buttons — Linear and Radial arm a creation tool (filled accent while armed; the next drag on the picture draws one and the tool disarms itself, so there is no mode to get stuck in; a drag under 8pt is discarded rather than committed as an invisible mask), and ＋ Custom… opens the existing file import. MASKS DECK: a 3-column grid of 4:3 tiles, one per project mask, in menu order — the two semantic regions, then the custom files, then the drawn shapes. White in a tile is the region that version SELECTS. Sky and Land carry the AUTO chip (they re-segment per seam) and draw the real analysis once it is cached, falling back to a stylised horizon before then — inference for a 48pt thumbnail would be absurd. An amber dot bottom-right marks a mask graded inside; ⊘ bottom-left marks one graded inverted; the selection is a 2.5pt accent ring. Clicking the selected tile deselects — nothing is analysed until a region is chosen. DETAIL CARD for the selection: a 30×24 tile, an editable name (parametric masks only), Remove (parametric only — Sky and Land belong to the analysis, and a custom mask is removed from its own list where its file is), then a Shape | Text segment (LLInkSegment: #E9E9EB track, selected seat in LL.ink with an LL.amber label). SHAPE · a drawn mask: Feather as a PERCENTAGE OF ITS OWN SPAN (drag the handles wider and the softness grows with them) plus Rotation −90…90° for a radial, and a footnote giving the size in points. Feather semantics: radial — everything inside 1 − feather of the radius is fully selected, falling to 0 at the ellipse; linear — the 50% line is the midpoint of start→end and the transition spans feather × distance centred on it. SHAPE · Sky or Land: the shipped dials, unchanged, moved into the detail card so every kind of mask is edited in one place — Camera locked off (ON, and the default: one mask voted across 25 frames beat any single frame’s at 0.975 vs 0.959 IoU, measured 2026-08-31), Threshold (disabled with a reason whenever the grid carries no confidence — an argmax model’s single frame holds two values and thresholding them cannot change anything), Feather, Edge bias (bipolar, default 0), and the provenance line. SHAPE · Custom: the inverted-name field and "Replace Sky & Land" (once per project). TEXT segment: the layers placed in this region as ID · copy · BOX/FREE rows, or the empty line — occlusion seen from the mask’s side. GRADE IN EDITOR: two rows, one per version, each with its own tile — "Grade Sun" and "Grade Sun · inverted". Either CREATES-OR-OPENS the MaskGrade (unique on (mask, inverted), so a second click re-opens rather than duplicating) and switches to the Editor tab with it expanded; a row whose grade exists reads the grade’s summary instead. PICTURE: the selected shape’s handles, drawn in LL.amber over the dark pane. STAGED HERE by LL_MASKGRADE=shapes: a radial "Sun" (centre 0.80/0.31, 124×80pt, −12°, feather 60%) and a linear "Quay lift", no grades — the deck’s own state. STATES NOT DRAWN (desc-only): the collapsed cardinal handles and their "small mask · handles collapsed — zoom in to edit" caption below min(rx,ry)=26pt; the create-drag HUD pill; the Text segment populated; the model-missing deck (Sky and Land dimmed to 40% and unclickable); the magenta "Show mask" tint, which is photo-viewer.masks.svg’s previous state and unchanged in behaviour. Hooks: LL_EDITOR=<uuid|latest>, LL_RAIL=masks, LL_MASKGRADE=shapes|first|empty, LL_MASKTOOL=linear|radial. Verified against the running Mac app 2026-09-07.
